profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Esquire Deposition Solutions
profile.summary: Seasoned Software Research and Development Director and Architect with experience leading teams and projects across a variety of industries. Proven track record of innovating new solutions from concept to enterprise production deployment. Focus on agile methodologies and test-driven development has resulted in consistent success as senior management of multiple products and lines of business in start-ups, midsize companies, and large international corporations.  Proven reputation as an expert technical leader at both a strategic and tactical level.

positions.title: Vice President of Business Process Management
Founder, CEO
positions.description:
A private consulting firm aimed at serving entrepreneurs with small-to-medium sized businesses in the region surrounding Charlotte, NC. The firm’s passion is helping those businesses achieve elevated performance by bridging gaps in their tactical and strategic technology plans without requiring them to commit to a full-time hire of senior entrepreneurial experience. Services are focused on:

• Leading collaborative efforts across the business to come up with new solutions
• Building multi-year strategy roadmaps to permanent solutions
• Discovering stories and requirements for how to reach new levels
• Providing senior leadership in all aspects of solution architecture, design and planning
• Managing implementation, deployment, and support with involvement across the business
• Identifying and mentoring additional resources as needed to control cost and schedules

The firm also leverages affiliation with a number of other senior entrepreneurs to bring specific expertise such as executive business management, marketing, sales, and operations to bear as needed.

positions.title: Chief Information Officer
positions.description: Huseby, Inc. is a global leader in court reporting, trial support services, interactive real-time technology and mobile litigation support services. Huseby empowers the on-the-go attorney by bringing their office to their mobile devices, allowing them to take depositions via web conference, access calendars and make changes to schedules, and reach critical case transcripts and exhibits from anywhere, securely.

positions.description: Lakeside Project Solutions, LLC., a provider of facilities management solutions tailored to meet client needs from small project maintenance to ongoing complete facilities management programs for Fortune 500 companies, has been named one of the 50 fastest growing companies in the Charlotte Metro Area by the Charlotte Business Journal.

positions.title: Advisory Board Member
positions.description: Provide business, marketing, and technology strategy advice to multiple start-ups and growth companies.

positions.title: Sr. Advisory Architect, ProfitStars Innovation Center
positions.description: The Innovation Center's used a FinTech start-up approach to create new product concepts that are not already on product roadmaps. The focus was on concepts that enable banks and credit unions to guide and encourage their customers toward optimal financial behaviors, broaden the institution's relationships with third parties, and generate new revenue streams for them. Over a period of 18 months a small team put over 100 product concepts into the product pipeline. Product ideas went through an initial marketing analysis, business modeling, and high-level solution architecture. High-quality prototypes were built from a number of the concepts and were used to demonstrate to customer customer and company senior management and industry analysts. Several concepts were taken into alpha development as a result of very positive feedback.  Focused alpha tests were conducted and detailed turnover documentation, code, and analysis to move those products to a dedicated team for beta development.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineering Manager, Enterprise Services Development
positions.description:
Managed Enterprise Services Development responsible for the development and delivery of all enterprise infrastructure services used by over 700 financial institutions.
• Led four teams in development of 10 products, including identity management, real-time message bus, enterprise workflow, and user experience framework for desktop and mobile
• Leveraged test-driven and agile development methodologies and fluid resource sharing between teams to concurrently deliver multiple releases of all products consistently on schedule
• Acted as senior software architect and lead developer for one team while performing senior manager duties

positions.title: Managing Director, Enterprise Exception Management/Business Intelligence
positions.description:
Owned all aspects of development and business management for multiple product lines including Enterprise Exception Management and Business Intelligence. 
• Managed business plans, budgets, forecasting, and P&L for three profit centers
• Created multi-year strategic roadmaps and provided hands-on technical/development leadership for 8 products
• Handled all aspects of hiring, HR, and personnel management
• Passed multiple R&D procedures and security audits with highest ratings and no significant findings

positions.title: Director, R&D
positions.description: Owned technical vision and strategy and managed development, deployment, and support of a variety of software solutions across multiple industries including software support, manufacturing, and health care. As one of the original partners was also responsible for helping plan and execute business and marketing strategy and implementation. Helped lead the company to becoming one of North Carolina's ten fastest growing technology companies and provided enterprise reconciliation software so some of the world's largest financial institutions.
